# TEDxKLH 2026: METAMORPHOSIS

> TEDxKLH 2026 is an independently organized TED event under official license from TED, hosted at KLH University, Bowrampet Campus, Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

## Core Event Details
- **Event Name**: TEDxKLH 2026
- **Theme**: METAMORPHOSIS — The Unseen Process of Becoming
- **Date**: Wednesday, November 4, 2026
- **Time**: 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM IST
- **Venue**: KLH Auditorium & Pavilion, KLH University Bowrampet Campus
- **Location**: ALEAP Industrial Area, Bowrampet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500043, India
- **Coordinates**: 17.5623° N, 78.3846° E
- **Official Website**: https://tedxklhbowrampet.in
- **Delegate Capacity**: 250 Curated Delegates
- **Official Registration Link**: https://tedxklhbowrampet.in/apply
- **Application Status Tracker**: https://tedxklhbowrampet.in/application-status
- **Contact Email**: tedxklhbowrampet@klh.edu.in

## Official Speakers (Announced)
1. **Sri Charan Lakkaraju**: Founder & CEO, Student Tribe. Youth-focused community builder empowering students across Tier 2 and Tier 3 colleges in India.
2. **Phani Gogireddy**: Founder & CEO, 24 Frames. Filmmaker, Director of Photography, Nikon India Influencer redefining luxury visual storytelling.
3. **Dr. Vikrant Singh Thakur**: Neurologist & Founder, TIME Neurocare. Advancing neurological care and healthcare accessibility in Telangana.
4. **Kumar Raja**: Founder & Creative Director, Design by Raja. Renowned luxury wedding planner and experiential spatial designer.
5. **Major General N D Prasad AVSM, VSM (Retd.)**: Decorated Indian Army veteran, former Dean of Army War College, and strategic affairs expert on national security.
6. **Moses Chowdari**: Trustee & COO, EnAble India. Disability inclusion pioneer, Helen Keller Awardee, transforming lives through assistive technology and employment.
7. **Poorna Malavath**: World's youngest girl to summit Mount Everest at age 13, Seven Summits conqueror, and Forbes India Self-Made Woman.
8. **Srikanth Acharya**: Founder & CEO, OffiNeeds. Entrepreneur transforming corporate gifting into purpose-driven relationship building.
9. **Tamal Chatterjee**: Chief Growth Officer, Sid's Farm. Seasoned business leader and IIM Bangalore alumnus with 23+ years driving market expansion and brand trust.
10. **Madhulash Babu Krovvidi**: Founder, Edodwaja. Social entrepreneur and Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia honoree pioneering the Futuristic Lab on Wheels (FLOW Bus) for rural STEM education.
11. **Mamatha Shanmugam**: Global Head – AWS Cloud COE, Financial Services, Capgemini. Technology leader driving cloud innovation, enterprise architecture, and financial services transformation.
